name: block-editor
title: Block editor
description: Notion-style block editor with slash commands, drag handle and a mobile bottom bar.

files.content:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Heading, Heading1, Heading2, Heading3 } from "@lucide/vue";
import { computed } from "vue";

const props = defineProps<{ level: number }>();

const icon = computed(
  () =>
    ({ 1: Heading1, 2: Heading2, 3: Heading3 })[props.level as 1 | 2 | 3] ??
    Heading
);
</script>

<template>
  <component :is="icon" />
</template>

import {
  Bold,
  Braces,
  Check,
  ChevronDown,
  Code,
  Copy,
  FileText,
  GripVertical,
  Heading,
  Image,
  Italic,
  Link,
  Link2Off,
  List,
  ListOrdered,
  ListTodo,
  Minus,
  Search,
  SquareCode,
  Strikethrough,
  Table,
  TextAlignCenter,
  TextAlignEnd,
  TextAlignStart,
  TextQuote,
  Trash2,
  Type,
  Underline,
  Video,
} from "@lucide/vue";

import { DEFAULT_LANGUAGE_ICONS } from "../editor/language-icons";
import type { BlockEditorIcons } from "./icon-types";

export const DEFAULT_ICONS: BlockEditorIcons = {
  alignCenterIcon: TextAlignCenter,
  alignLeftIcon: TextAlignStart,
  alignRightIcon: TextAlignEnd,
  boldIcon: Bold,
  checkIcon: Check,
  codeBlockLanguageIcon: Braces,
  codeIcon: Code,
  copyIcon: Copy,
  deleteIcon: Trash2,
  dragHandleIcon: GripVertical,
  dropdownArrowIcon: ChevronDown,
  fallbackIcon: FileText,
  italicIcon: Italic,
  languageIcons: DEFAULT_LANGUAGE_ICONS,
  linkIcon: Link,
  searchIcon: Search,
  slashBlockquoteIcon: TextQuote,
  slashBulletListIcon: List,
  slashCodeBlockIcon: SquareCode,
  slashDividerIcon: Minus,
  slashHeadingIcon: Heading,
  slashImageIcon: Image,
  slashOrderedListIcon: ListOrdered,
  slashTableIcon: Table,
  slashTaskListIcon: ListTodo,
  slashTextIcon: Type,
  slashVideoIcon: Video,
  strikethroughIcon: Strikethrough,
  underlineIcon: Underline,
  unlinkIcon: Link2Off,
};
